// binary writer, generated by kohakutt.dsl.metal.
// Change the program's model, not this file.
#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: out address, groups_base, groups_extra, nr, block, sr.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto out_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_out = 16;
    const uint32_t out_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t groups_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t groups_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t nr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t block = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t sr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(5);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = groups_base + (core < groups_extra ? 1 : 0);
    const uint32_t start = (core * groups_base) + (core < groups_extra ? core : groups_extra);
    const auto out = TensorAccessor(out_args, out_addr, 2048);
    for (uint32_t g = 0; g < count; ++g) {
        const uint32_t j = start + g;
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < nr; r += block) {
            cb_wait_front(cb_out, block);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < block; ++i) {
                noc_async_write_page(((r + i) * sr) + j, out, get_read_ptr(cb_out) + i * 2048);
            }
            noc_async_writes_flushed();
            cb_pop_front(cb_out, block);
        }
    }
    noc_async_write_barrier();
}
